encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: σὺ δὲ μηκέτ’ ἔγχει, παιδάριον, εἰς ἀργυροῦν·
εἰς τὸ βαθὺ πάλιν ἄγωμεν. εἰς τὸν κάνθαρον,
παιδάριον, ἔγχει. Β. νὴ Δία, νὴ τὸν κάνθαρον.

div.note: Athenaeus 11, 473f Ξέναρχος ἐν Πριάπῳ φησὶ τάδε κτλ.

2. δὲ πάλιν A. A. σὺ δὲ — τἀργυροῦν. B. εἰς τὸ βαθὺ πάλιν ἄγωμεν. A. εἰς τὸν κάνθαρον — ἔγχει, νὴ Δία. Γ. ναί, τὸν κάνθαρον. Dobr. Append. Arist. p. 113 (B est minister, A et Γ convivae). εἰς τὸ βαθὺ δ’ ἐπανάγωμεν Mein. 3. νὴ Δί’ εἰς τὸν κ. Hanov. Exerc. crit. 151. ac νὴ Δί’ A. sed poterat eum ridicule per cantharum etiam iurantem facere. 1. nescio quo iure opponatur vas argenteum profundo. 2. si vera est Meinekii emendatio, ἐπανάγωμεν (vel ἐπαναγώμεθ’) petitum est e re nautica.
